source: Council on Revenues forecast (May 21, 2026), allocated by tax type per the Dept. of Budget & Finance FY27 Executive Supplemental revenue estimates (Dec 2025, scaled ×1.0131)

taxes.name: General excise & use (GET)
taxes.who: 4% (plus the counties' 0.5% surcharge) on nearly every transaction — everyone pays it at the register

taxes.name: Individual income tax
taxes.who: Tax on residents' income — the gold streams on the map. Shrinking as the 2024 income-tax cuts phase in

taxes.name: Transient accommodations (TAT)
taxes.who: 11% on hotel and vacation-rental stays (10.25% + the 2026 climate fee) — mostly visitors; this is the general fund's share

taxes.name: Estate tax
taxes.who: Tax on large estates — spiky from year to year

taxes.name: Insurance premiums tax
taxes.who: Levy on insurers, paid in lieu of GET

taxes.name: Public service companies
taxes.who: Utilities pay this instead of GET

taxes.name: Conveyance tax
taxes.who: On real-estate sales, graduated by price — the general fund's share

taxes.name: Tobacco tax
taxes.who: Per-pack cigarette excises — fading as smoking declines

taxes.name: Banks & financial corporations
taxes.who: Franchise tax banks pay instead of the corporate income tax

taxes.name: All other taxes & fees
taxes.who: Penalties and interest, license fees, and small allocations from other taxes
